training: No new weights trained. These VAD models do not establish sibilance identity; upstream overlap with the development recordings is unknown.
decision_policy: Causal 10 ms key packets, trailing 20 ms raw one-sided FFT bin-power fraction and hysteresis, raw VAD score thresholds 0.2/0.8; missing/unwarmed/uncertain/stale context selects the classical key with a smoothed return after prior protection. A score must remain within the 150 ms age budget through the whole nominal packet.
native_contract: Existing native de-esser, explicit external key and bounded Range; no additional programme buffering. Native public delay/FIR drain retained; recursive minimum-phase ringing is truncated by existing drain contract. Key modulation can create detector transients, so no pointwise reduction-below-classical claim.
scope: Offline 48 kHz mono score/key analysis and linked stereo native development evaluation. Native renderer supports bounded 1..8 channels at 44.1..192 kHz; this is not learned quality acceptance across that domain.
remaining: Train/validate a dedicated speech-conditioned sibilance detector on adequate speaker/source-disjoint labels; do not train or claim population accuracy from the existing five clips.
Unseen conversational/multilingual, initial/final/whispered and voiced fricatives, legitimate music highs, noise/level/rate/layout shifts and listening acceptance.
Realtime worker/host lifecycle, discontinuity/reset, unavailable-model and staleness policy integration plus controlled CPU/memory/deadline budgets; current observer uses explicit Offline mode.
Perceptual validation of key modulation and boundary behavior; offline prefix and native Range tests do not establish phonetic correctness.
